'''Iseno''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. Its people had a strong military tradition and maintained a large army mostly used for ornamental honor guard purposes.

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]], a wealthy [[General/Legends|General]] received an arms shipment for an attempted military coup, promising to ally with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Military Takeover}}</ref>

The planet was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Ronet Coorr]], who supported the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] and was appointed to the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ronet Coorr moved the naval forces in Iseno&mdash;meant to reinforce the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]] in case of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attack&mdash;to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], due to a bribe from [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]]. This led to Duro being underdefended and falling to [[Operation Durge's Lance]]. Coorr's role in the scandal was exposed, forcing his disgraced resignation from the Senate and recall to Iseno.
